subject: Mutual action plan: Horizon Biotech evaluation & POC timeline
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Dana Liu <dana.liu@horizonbio.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan: Horizon Biotech evaluation & POC timeline

Hi Dana —

Great to meet on the call earlier. Per our conversation I wanted to start a lightweight mutual action plan (MAP) so we can align stakeholders, success criteria, and a close/POC timeline. High level goals you called out:

- Verify inference latency and tail latency at 95th percentile under our expected traffic profile
- Measure token-cost per request and projected monthly spend for your two workload classes (analytics vs. user-facing)
- Confirm security controls (VPC, KMS, audit logs) and remediation path for any gaps

Suggested timeline (flexible):
- Week 1 (this week): finalize MAP and identify owners
- Week 2–3: sandbox POC (integration + perf runs)
- Week 4: results review, pricing/contract conversation

I've attached a short MAP template you can edit directly (Horizon_MAP_Template.xlsx). If that looks good, could you:

1) Confirm the primary champion and day-to-day technical lead on your side
2) Confirm any procurement approvers we should loop in now (legal/finance)
3) Share any hard deadlines (e.g., board/quarter close) that drive the June window

I'll loop in Marissa (Solutions) and Ben (Sales lead) once you confirm owners.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this.

Best,

Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@horizonbio.com>, Elena Morales <elena.morales@horizonbio.com>

Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: Horizon Biotech evaluation & POC timeline

Thanks Karthik — this format is perfect. I'll be the project champion and will own decisioning alongside Elena (CTO). Adding Samir (procurement) to the thread for any contract/terms questions.

To be explicit on goals from our side:
- Goal A: Validate 95th pct latency < 300ms for the analytics workload at up to 250 concurrent users
- Goal B: Demonstrate 2x cost savings vs our current GPU infra for the conversational workload at 1M tokens/month
- Goal C: Ensure Redwood can meet our SOC2 + encryption-at-rest requirements; provide a short controls matrix we can use in our review

Timeline constraints: our Q2 planning cycle ends 2026-06-30; ideal close date is the week of 6/22 so vendor selection can be included in next quarter's budget. If we need more time for security review, flag that early.

Owners:
- Champion / Executive sponsor: Dana Liu (Product Ops)
- Technical lead: Elena Morales (CTO)
- Procurement / Legal: Samir Patel

Samir / Elena — please weigh in if you want changes to timeline or the scope.

Thanks,
Dana

Dana Liu
Director, Product Operations | Horizon Biotech
dana.liu@horizonbio.com | +1 (617) 555-9876

Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: Horizon Biotech evaluation & POC timeline

Appreciate the clarity, Dana — that's very helpful. I've updated the MAP template and attached a short POC test spec doc (POC_Test_Specs.pdf) that Marissa will use to validate perf/cost. Summary of proposed owners and milestones below — please confirm or edit directly in the attached spreadsheet:

Owners (proposed):
- Champion / Exec: Dana Liu (Horizon)
- Technical lead: Elena Morales (Horizon)
- Procurement: Samir Patel (Horizon)
- Redwood AE: Karthik Iyer
- Redwood Solutions Eng: Marissa Cole
- Redwood Sales Manager: Ben Carter

Milestones (proposed):
- May 11–15: integrate sandbox, auth, and sample dataset; initial smoke tests
- May 18–22: load/perf runs + cost modeling; 2 test windows to capture peak behavior
- May 25: preliminary findings & tuning call
- Week of Jun 22: negotiation & PO (target close)

Open questions for the MAP (please reply inline in the sheet or here):
1) Any non-negotiable legal terms (e.g., indemnity, data residency) Samir wants flagged now?
2) Does Elena want any additional telemetry captured during perf runs besides token latency and tail percentiles?

I'll schedule a 30-minute kickoff for Tue May 12 or Wed May 13 — Marissa, can you propose two 30-min slots? Samir / Elena / Dana — tell us which works best.

Links: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/1893

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Dana Liu <dana.liu@horizonbio.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@horizonbio.com>, Elena Morales <elena.morales@horizonbio.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: Horizon Biotech evaluation & POC timeline

Thanks Karthik / Dana — I'm on it. Two quick notes:

1) Kickoff slots (all PDT): Tue May 12 11:00–11:30 or Wed May 13 10:00–10:30. I blocked both tentatively — please reply with preference.

2) POC test plan highlights (from the attached spec):
- Integration: simple SDK auth + sample dataset ingestion (goal: <2 hours to a first inference)
- Perf: 3x 30-minute windows capturing cold, warm, and burst traffic; we'll surface 50/95/99 pct latencies and token costs per window
- Security: short controls checklist we can fill in during the first week; I'll attach a one-page controls matrix after kickoff

Samir — I hear the legal flags; if you can send any non-starter clauses now we can surface to our legal early.

See you on the kickoff — looking forward.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (510) 555-3344
